laws.rule: Petra for foreigners: one day JD 50, two days JD 55, three days JD 60 for visitors staying at least one night in Jordan; JD 90 for a one-day visitor not staying overnight. (No RBA rate for JOD; at the Central Bank of Jordan rate of 30 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 0.4991 JOD: JD 50 ≈ A$100; JD 55 ≈ A$110; JD 60 ≈ A$120; JD 90 ≈ A$180)

Multi-day tickets must be used on consecutive days; a valid passport must be shown at the ticket office; children under 12 enter free by day. Petra by Night needs a separate ticket and is not covered by day tickets or the Jordan Pass; tickets are non-refundable and non-transferable.

laws.rule: The Jordan Pass (JD 70, 75 or 80 for one, two or three Petra days) includes entry to over 40 sites and waives the tourist visa fee if bought before arrival and you stay at least two nights (3 days).
